scope: NGS J6 Illinois default (06101 / 06102); other Medicare contractors reference only
limitations: CMS crosswalks are not a complete US drug directory.
ICD-10 matches are article-level co-listings, not a validated drug-diagnosis crosswalk or coverage approval.
Diagnosis and HCPCS group numbers are retained independently; their numbers do not establish a relationship.

Current downloaded Medicare contractor articles listing mapped HCPCS are indexed. NGS J6 Illinois is the default; other-contractor articles are reference only and do not establish Illinois coverage. NCDs, Medicaid and commercial policies are not included.
Latest-version download can omit an earlier in-effect version when a future revision exists.
G/K/N are OPPS indicators; CAH payment and drug waste eligibility cannot be inferred from these letters.
Numeric CPT rows and CPT descriptors are excluded from this free-source reference.
Updates require rebuilding and redeploying; no automatic refresh is configured.
